Class TVSeries

java.lang.Object
MediaEntry
TVSeries
public class TVSeries extends MediaEntry
Represents an episodic television series in a MediaVault library. On top of the attributes every media entry carries, a TVSeries tracks how many episodes it contains, how many of those the user has watched, and how many seasons it spans.

  • Constructor Details

    • TVSeries

      public TVSeries(String title, String genre, MediaStatus status, int totalEps, int watchedEps, int seasonCount)
      Constructs a new TVSeries with the given shared and series-specific details.

      Precondition: totalEps and seasonCount are positive, and watchedEps is between 0 and totalEps
      Postcondition: the TVSeries is created with no rating or review

      Parameters:
      title - the title of the series
      genre - the genre of the series
      status - the initial status of the series
      totalEps - the total number of episodes in the series
      watchedEps - the number of episodes already watched
      seasonCount - the number of seasons in the series

  • Method Details

    • updateWatchedEpisodes

      public boolean updateWatchedEpisodes(int episodes)
      Updates how many episodes of this series have been watched. Viewing progress only ever moves forward, so the update is rejected when the given count is negative, exceeds the total number of episodes, or is not greater than the count already recorded. Re-entering the current count therefore counts as no progress and is rejected.

      Postcondition: watchedEpisodes is updated only when the given count is greater than the current count and at most the total number of episodes; otherwise the series is left unchanged

      Parameters:
      episodes - the new number of watched episodes
      Returns:
      true if the count was updated, false if it was out of range or would not move progress forward
